image_description: An outdoor scene featuring two rain barrels positioned against the side of a house with beige siding. The primary subject is a tall, dark green/black cylindrical plastic barrel connected to a white downspout via a diverter system. A secondary, shorter reddish-brown barrel sits on the ground to the left. The background includes a grassy yard, a fence, and a small shed.
